title: Ecobee HVAC Runtime Weekly Filter Runtime Trend
dataSources: LG ThinQ washer cycles (`thinq:washer`), LG ThinQ dryer cycles (`thinq:dryer`), Home Connect dishwasher runs (`homeconnect:dishwasher`), and ecobee HVAC runtime (`ecobee:thermostat`).
app: LG ThinQ washer and dryer telemetry, Home Connect dishwasher data, and ecobee HVAC runtime exported into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ecobee:thermostat runtime_minutes=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(runtime_minutes) as avg_duration, max(runtime_minutes) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst filter runtime for ecobee HVAC runtime events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture runtime_minutes on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average filter runtime with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It frames whether ecobee HVAC runtime tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
